latestVersion.changelog:
alibabacloud-milvus-manage 0.0.3

- Enforces explicit User-Agent requirements for both aliyun CLI (`--user-agent AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-milvus-manage`) and pymilvus SDK connections.
- Alibaba Cloud CLI minimum version is now 3.3.3 (was 3.0).
- Clarifies that every CLI command must include the User-Agent flag.
- Updates and reorganizes routing, prerequisites, and safety/guardrail sections for greater clarity.
- Adds explicit guidance for required grpc_options when connecting via pymilvus.
- Documentation improvements across reference files for parameter and operational clarity.
